Joins pre-aggregated 2025 311 and code violation counts per tract with CDC total population, computes per-1,000-resident rates for each, keeps only fully paired non-null tracts, and returns the cross-tract correlation and paired count ordered by 311 rate descending.
sql:
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT geoid,
         SUM(CASE WHEN source = 'm1_city' THEN CAST(n AS DOUBLE) END) AS request_count,
         SUM(CASE WHEN source = 'm2_city' THEN CAST(n AS DOUBLE) END) AS violation_count
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261026_857dda' AND source IN ('m1_city', 'm2_city') AND grp = 'all'
  GROUP BY geoid
),
pop AS (
  SELECT tractfips AS geoid, CAST(totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS totalpopulation
  FROM session.fw_857dda_m3_cdc
),
paired AS (
  SELECT t.name, t.geoid,
         c.request_count,
         c.violation_count,
         p.totalpopulation,
         (c.request_count / p.totalpopulation) * 1000.0 AS requests_per_1000_residents,
         (c.violation_count / p.totalpopulation) * 1000.0 AS violations_per_1000_residents
  FROM fw_pg.tracts t
  JOIN counts c ON t.geoid = c.geoid
  JOIN pop p ON t.geoid = p.geoid
  WHERE c.request_count IS NOT NULL AND c.violation_count IS NOT NULL AND p.totalpopulation IS NOT NULL AND p.totalpopulation > 0
)
SELECT name,
       requests_per_1000_residents,
       violations_per_1000_residents,
       request_count,
       violation_count,
       totalpopulation,
       CORR(requests_per_1000_residents, violations_per_1000_residents) OVER () AS correlation,
       COUNT(*) OVER () AS paired_tracts,
       geoid
FROM paired
ORDER BY requests_per_1000_residents DESC NULLS LAST, name ASC
LIMIT 200

CREATE SCHEMASTORE VIEW answer_857dda WITH CONTAINER fieldwork_answers AS WITH counts AS (
  SELECT geoid,
         SUM(CASE WHEN source = 'm1_city' THEN CAST(n AS DOUBLE) END) AS request_count,
         SUM(CASE WHEN source = 'm2_city' THEN CAST(n AS DOUBLE) END) AS violation_count
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261026_857dda' AND source IN ('m1_city', 'm2_city') AND grp = 'all'
  GROUP BY geoid
),
pop AS (
  SELECT tractfips AS geoid, CAST(totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS totalpopulation
  FROM session.fw_857dda_m3_cdc
),
paired AS (
  SELECT t.name, t.geoid,
         COALESCE(c.request_count, 0) AS request_count,
         COALESCE(c.violation_count, 0) AS violation_count,
         p.totalpopulation,
         (COALESCE(c.request_count, 0) / p.totalpopulation) * 1000.0 AS requests_per_1000_residents,
         (COALESCE(c.violation_count, 0) / p.totalpopulation) * 1000.0 AS violations_per_1000_residents
  FROM fw_pg.tracts t
  LEFT JOIN counts c ON t.geoid = c.geoid
  LEFT JOIN pop p ON t.geoid = p.geoid
  WHERE p.totalpopulation IS NOT NULL AND p.totalpopulation > 0
)
SELECT name,
       requests_per_1000_residents,
       violations_per_1000_residents,
       request_count,
       violation_count,
       totalpopulation,
       CORR(requests_per_1000_residents, violations_per_1000_residents) OVER () AS correlation,
       COUNT(*) OVER () AS paired_tracts,

FROM paired
